title: Fresh review, bounded repair, differential audit, and control-plane sync

objective.statement: Run one read-only fresh-context review, repair only reproduced P0/P1, run final differential audit, publish one draft stacked PR, and synchronize PM-7 plus the canonical Confluence page.
objective.observable_success: P0=P1=0 or an explicit blocked state; GitHub/Jira/Confluence pointers agree.
non_goals: Changing scientific tolerances or expected outputs

P0_failure_modes.trigger: Fresh reviewer repairs code before issuing reproducible findings.

required_detection.test: review artifact contains read-only first-pass findings

P1_failure_modes.trigger: Unreproduced P2/P3 is inflated into blocker or process loop.

required_detection.test: P0/P1 repair ledger and anti-meta cycle count

P1_failure_modes.trigger: Atlassian is unavailable but cross-plane completion is claimed.
Implementation PR targets main and duplicates PR #20 without explicit retarget policy.

forbidden_changes: Do not change reference tolerances or expected scientific outputs to make tests pass.
Do not guess across a scientific or numerical specification boundary.
Do not suppress failed stages, cells, tests, or Atlassian drift.

ordered_steps.action: Run the supplied fresh review prompt in a new context; first pass is read-only.
Repair only reproducible P0/P1 findings and rerun their falsifying checks plus affected regression.
Audit only base..final delta, contract, evidence, fresh review, and blockers.
Commit, push, open one draft stacked PR, then update Jira PM-7 and Confluence with exact branch/commit/tree/PR/evidence state.
Only when Atlassian write/readback is unavailable, record pending fields and forbid cross-plane PASS.
